channel.title: EngineerzCorneR — Posts
channel.description: Deep-dive technical write-ups across Electrical, Mechanical, HVAC, Automation, Civil and Solar.

item.title: Basics of Fire Protection in Buildings Explained
item.description: Passive protection, active systems, detection, suppression and evacuation — the five layers of building fire protection and how they work together.

item.title: Chiller Capacity and COP: Where the Compressor's Work Actually Goes
item.description: Refrigeration cycle capacity, COP and compressor power, and why condenser heat rejection has to account for the compressor's work input.

item.title: What Is an ELV System? Types, Components & the BIM Engineer's Role
item.description: Extra Low Voltage systems explained: the six categories, how ELV differs from electrical power systems, and where MEP BIM fits in.

item.title: Fire Alarm Systems Explained: Detection, Circuits and Standby Power
item.description: How a fire alarm system works from detector to evacuation signal, conventional vs addressable panels, NFPA 72 detector spacing, circuit classes and battery standby sizing.

item.title: Flame Retardant vs Flame Resistant Cables: Know the Difference
item.description: IEC 60332 vs IEC 60331 explained — why flame retardant cables stop fire from spreading while flame (fire) resistant cables keep circuits alive during a fire.

item.title: Heat Pump Sizing Basics: Why Electrification Made This a Core Skill
item.description: Why heat pump sizing isn't the same exercise as furnace or AC sizing, what COP and capacity-at-temperature actually mean.

item.title: Row Spacing & Inter-Row Shading: Sizing the Gap Between Solar Rows
item.description: Why ground-mount and rooftop solar rows need a minimum gap, how the winter-solstice sun angle sets that gap, and the ground coverage ratio trade-off behind it.

item.title: SEER, EER and COP Explained: Reading Cooling Efficiency Ratings Correctly
item.description: How COP, EER, SEER and SEER2 relate, the exact COP-to-EER conversion, why SEER has no exact formula, and which rating to use when comparing equipment.

item.title: String vs Microinverter vs Power Optimizer: Choosing a Solar Inverter Topology
item.description: How string inverters, microinverters and power optimizers differ in where MPPT happens, what a shaded panel costs under each, and how to pick between them.

item.title: Solar Panel Derating: Why Nameplate Wattage Isn't What You Get
item.description: The STC nameplate rating on a solar panel assumes lab conditions no rooftop ever sees.

item.title: Solar Shading and Soiling Losses: Why Small Obstructions Cost More Than Their Size
item.description: Why a small shadow cuts output more than its area, how bypass diodes limit the damage, typical soiling losses, and how to decide whether panel cleaning pays.

item.title: Earthing vs. Grounding: Same Earth Connection, Different Job
item.description: Earthing and grounding both connect to earth, but serve different purposes — earthing protects people from shock, grounding protects the electrical system.

item.title: How to Read a Wiring Diagram (Beginner's Guide)
item.description: What a wiring diagram shows, how it differs from a schematic and a single line diagram, the common symbols and how wires are numbered: a beginner's guide.

item.title: kW, kVA, and kVAR: What Actually Separates Them
item.description: Real power, apparent power, and reactive power explained through the power triangle.

item.title: Pipe Head Loss: Why Reynolds Number Decides Which Formula Applies
item.description: Pipe flow velocity, Reynolds number, friction factor and head loss.

item.title: Pipe Thermal Expansion: Why a 100m Run Moves More Than You'd Guess
item.description: Linear thermal expansion of a pipe run from material, length and temperature change.

item.title: Pipe Wall Thickness (ASME B31.3)
item.description: ASME B31.3 pressure design thickness, corrosion allowance and the 12.5% mill tolerance, with a worked NPS 6 example and schedule selection.

item.title: Relay Basics: Construction, Working Principle & Contact Types
item.description: What a relay is, how the coil and armature switch a separate power circuit, NO/NC/CO contact types, common applications, and trade-offs vs solid-state relays.

item.title: System Voltages Explained: Low, Medium & High Voltage Levels and Phases
item.description: Voltage classification from ELV to UHV explained — IEC vs IEEE ranges, standard system voltages used worldwide, and single-phase vs three-phase configurations.

item.title: Level Control of an Integrating Process
item.description: Why tank level is an integrating process, why P-only control leaves an offset, and how PI damping depends on Kp and Ki, with numbers you can reproduce.

item.title: Calendar Days vs Business Days Explained
item.description: How to count calendar and business days for contract deadlines: inclusive vs exclusive counts, weekends, holidays, month ends and leap years, with examples.

item.title: Vessel Purging and Inerting Explained
item.description: Dilution purge turnovers, pressure-swing cycles and NFPA 69 oxygen targets, with worked examples for taking a vessel from air to a safe oxygen level.

item.title: Battery SoC vs DoD: Why They're Not the Same Number
item.description: Why SoC and DoD are two views of the same battery, how SoC is actually estimated in the field, and why chemistry sets the DoD limit that protects cycle life.

item.title: Solar Payback Period & ROI: What the Simple Formula Leaves Out
item.description: Why simple payback (cost divided by annual savings) overstates solar economics, and what degradation and rising electricity prices do to the real payback.

item.title: Solar System Sizing: From Daily Load to Panel Count
item.description: How to go from a daily energy load in kWh to an array size in kW, why peak sun hours (not daylight hours) matters, and where the derating factors go.

item.title: Arc Flash Hazard Basics
item.description: What drives arc flash incident energy, the variables in a study, NFPA 70E PPE categories 1–4, the arc flash boundary, and ways to reduce incident energy.

item.title: BESS Types & Components Explained
item.description: BESS chemistries (LFP, NMC, lead-acid, sodium-ion, flow) compared, main components (cells, BMS, PCS, EMS), selection by duration, and C-rate explained.

item.title: Binary, Hex & Octal Explained
item.description: Decimal, binary, octal and hex are one number in different bases: what a base means, why hex shortens binary, and how to convert by hand.

item.title: Circuit Breaker Types Explained: MCB to OCB
item.description: What a circuit breaker does, the main types (MCB, MCCB, ACB, VCB, OCB, SF6, GIS), their parts, interrupting media, voltage-class selection and failure points.

item.title: Cooling Tower Types Explained
item.description: What a cooling tower does, the main types (counterflow, crossflow, natural, forced and induced draft, open, closed, hybrid), parts, selection and failures.
